# data_manifest.txt
#
# Records exactly which upstream data was fetched into data/raw/, when, and at
# which upstream commit — so a build can be reproduced from a known input state.
#
# This file is (re)generated by fetch_data.sh on every fetch. The entries below
# are a placeholder showing the expected format; run ./fetch_data.sh to populate
# them with real values.
#
# Fetched at: <not yet fetched>
#
# source:      https://github.com/JeffSackmann/tennis_atp.git
# local_path:  data/raw/tennis_atp
# commit:      <upstream commit hash>
# csv_files:   <count>
#
# source:      https://github.com/JeffSackmann/tennis_wta.git
# local_path:  data/raw/tennis_wta
# commit:      <upstream commit hash>
# csv_files:   <count>
